properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is a blockchain (Ethereum) Ledger app: secp256k1 ECDSA is its core signature scheme. The Makefile declares the curve for app load params, trusted names must be signed with SIG_ALGO_SECP256K1, and tests use secp256k1 as reference. The actual BIP32-derived ECDSA sign/verify call sites use the constant CX_CURVE_256K1 and were missed by the regex — reported separately as findings.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Unit-test sites in test_cmd_perform_privacy_operation.c are SDK stubs/mocks of cx_x25519 that exercise the same feature; covered by this same object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Functional-test dependency: tests/functional/requirements.txt:2 declares the pure-Python ecdsa package, used by the test suite (test_clone.py, test_get_address.py etc.) to compute reference BIP32 secp256k1 keys against the device. Same declaration also pins web3~=7.0 and py_ecc (BLS12-381), reported separately.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is Ethereum's hashing backbone: the tx RLP stream (eth_ustream.c:69), personal-message hashing (cmd_sign_message.c:81), EIP-712 domain/message/type hashing (common_712.c, type_hash.c, value_hash.c), EIP-7702 authorization hashing (commands_7702.c:109), the Python client's tx-hash/address computation (client.py:211), selector-cache generation (tools/generate_selector_cache.py:21), plus SDK mocks in unit tests and the fuzz harness. Keccak-256 (pre-standard SHA-3 padding) is quantum-unsa

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is the app's payload-integrity hash: every CAL/TLV "provide_*" feature (network info, trusted names, enum values, gating, map entries, proxy info, Safe account descriptors, tx-info parser) hashes the host-supplied payload with cx_sha256_init/update/final before ECDSA verification, and the eth2/staking tests hash withdrawal credentials. Swap-with-calldata SHA-256 (cx_sha256_init_no_throw variant) was missed by the collector and is reported separately.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: One logical asset with ALG-710f61f0: both objects stem from the same "ecdsa" line in tests/functional/requirements.txt — the package and the algorithm it provides.
